name: Lean season
description: An empty husk with one bead of jelly in it. The husk is drawn as an open ring with its mouth turned to the viewer and nothing but the plate's dark inside, so the emptiness is the object and the jelly is the exception — the find takes the field's food away and pays in jelly instead. The bead is the currency's own (`ss.pickup.coin`), composed in. One bead, sitting low, because a heap would have read as a good year.

glyph.description: Plate off, object only — the silhouette a collection shows for an entry not yet met.
